title: LLM Guardrails: Keeping Large Language Models in Check
description: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful tools, but like any powerful tool, they need guardrails to ensure safe and ethical use. These guardrails are essentially guidelines and controls that steer the LLM's outputs in the desired direction.
